pwa.title: Get the Mahaam app
pwa.description: Install Mahaam on this device and get notified when you are assigned, mentioned, or a timer keeps running.
pwa.installHint: Opens in its own window, from your home screen or dock.
pwa.browserMenu: Open your browser menu and choose Install app (or Add to Home Screen).
pwa.pushHint: Get assignments, mentions and reminders on this device, even when Mahaam is closed.
pwa.pushOn: Notifications are on for this device.
pwa.pushOff: Notifications are not available on this server yet.
pwa.pushUnsupported: This browser does not support notifications.
pwa.pushIos: On iPhone and iPad, install the app first (Add to Home Screen), then open it and turn notifications on.
pwa.permissionDenied: Notifications are blocked. Allow them for this site in your browser settings and try again.
mcp.projectsHint: Limit this token to some projects: an agent then sees and files issues and tasks only there. Leave “All projects” for everything you can see.
connect.pickHint: Pick the AI app you want to connect to Mahaam. You can connect more than one.
connect.keyFirst: This app needs a personal key to reach your workspace. Create one below; it takes a few seconds.
connect.keyOnce: Your key is shown only once. If you lose it, just create a new one.
connect.claude.2: In Claude, open Settings → Connectors → Add custom connector. Name it “Mahaam”, paste the link and press Add.
connect.claude.3: Press Connect, sign in to Mahaam and approve. Done!
connect.chatgpt.2: In ChatGPT, open Settings → Apps & Connectors → Advanced, turn on Developer mode, then press Create and paste the link.
connect.chatgpt.3: Choose OAuth, sign in to Mahaam and approve. Done!
connect.code.1: Copy the command and paste it in your terminal.
connect.code.2: In Claude Code type /mcp, choose “mahaam”, press Authenticate, then sign in to Mahaam and approve.
connect.cursor.1: Press the button. Cursor opens and asks to add Mahaam — say yes.
connect.cursor.2: In Cursor Settings → MCP, make sure “mahaam” is switched on.
connect.vscode.1: Press the button. VS Code opens and asks to install Mahaam — say yes.
connect.vscode.2: Open Copilot Chat in Agent mode; Mahaam's tools appear in the tools list.
connect.other.1: In your app, add a new MCP server and paste this link as its address.
connect.other.2: Where it asks for an “Authorization” header, paste your key.
connect.tryHint: “What are my tasks today?” or “Start a timer on MH-12.”
mcp.connectSheetHint: Choose how you want to connect to this workspace.
mcp.apiHint: Build on Mahaam directly. Every resource is on both the REST API and GraphQL; the docs list the endpoints and their scopes.
mcp.connectHint: Mint a token and get ready-to-paste setup for Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Cursor or any other MCP client.
mcp.connectDefaultScopeHint: Starts with a broad set of read/write scopes for projects, tasks, issues and time.
mcp.claudeDesktopCursorHint: Add this under "mcpServers" in the app's MCP config file.
mcp.oauthClientsHint: Claude.ai and ChatGPT's remote connectors can now use this server URL directly (they discover OAuth automatically and show their own sign-in/consent screen) — no token needed for those. Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Cursor and Windsurf still use the token above.
mcp.kitTitle: Plugins for Claude Code, ChatGPT and Codex
mcp.kitHint: The Mahaam AI kit adds skills, agents and AI-cost tracking on top of the MCP server. No token needed: these clients sign in with OAuth.
mcp.kitClaudeHint: Run both commands in Claude Code, then /mcp → mahaam → Authenticate and pick this workspace. Link a repo with /mahaam:setup.
mcp.kitSelfHosted: Set this before starting Claude Code:
mcp.kitChatgptHint: Settings → Apps & Connectors → Advanced → Developer mode, then Create: paste this URL, choose OAuth and approve on Mahaam's consent screen.
mcp.kitCodexHint: Append to ~/.codex/config.toml and export MAHAAM_TOKEN with a token from this page. Skills are in the plugin repo.
oauth.title: Connect an AI app
oauth.hint: An external app is asking to connect to your Mahaam account.
oauth.wantsToConnect: wants to connect to your Mahaam workspace.
oauth.noWorkspaces: You don't belong to any workspace yet.
oauth.badRequest: This connection request is missing something it needs (client, redirect address, or PKCE parameters) — ask the app you're connecting to try again.
auth.resetBadCode: That code isn't valid, or it has expired. Codes work for 10 minutes and five tries. Send a new one if you need to.
auth.resetHint: We'll email you a six-digit code. Enter it here with a new password.
auth.resetSent: If {email} has a Mahaam account, a code is on its way. It works for 10 minutes.
auth.resetSignsOut: At least 8 characters. Every device signed in to this account will be signed out.
auth.resetTooMany: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
account.title: Your account
account.hint: How you appear to your teams, the language and timezone you want, and how you sign in. It applies in every workspace.
account.name: Name
account.timezoneHint: Leave empty to follow this device.
account.avatarFormat: Use a JPEG, PNG or GIF picture.
account.avatarTooBig: That picture is too large. Use one under 10 MB.
account.emailSent: If {email} can be used, a code is on its way there. Nothing changes until you enter it.
account.emailChanged: Your email was changed. Sign in with the new address from now on.
account.deleteHint: Signs you out everywhere at once and ends every token and connected agent. Your account is deleted for good after 14 days; sign in before then to cancel. Work you did in shared workspaces stays, attributed to a deleted user.
account.reauthBody: You sign in with Apple, Google or GitHub, so there's no password to ask for. We'll email you a code to confirm it's you.
account.reauthSent: We sent a code to {email}. It works for 10 minutes.
account.reauthRequired: Confirm it's you first: ask for a code by email.
account.reauthWrong: That code isn't right or has expired. Ask for a new one.
account.reauthTooMany: Too many codes asked for. Wait a few minutes and try again.
auth.oauthAccountExists: An account with this email already exists, and the provider hasn't verified the address. Sign in to that account another way.
auth.oauthEmailRequired: The provider didn't share an email address. Allow it when you sign in, or sign in another way.
account.deleteSoleOwner: You're the only owner of these workspaces. Make someone else an owner, or delete them, first:
auth.deletedNotice: Your account will be deleted on {date}. Sign in before then to cancel the deletion.
legal.draft: Draft: this text is waiting for final review and may still change before it takes effect.
auth.consent: By creating an account you agree to the {terms} and the {privacy}.
verify.sent: We sent a six-digit code to {email}. Enter it to confirm the address and create your workspace.
verify.why: You can use workspaces you're invited to straight away; starting a new one needs a confirmed address.
verify.resent: A new code is on its way.
auth.mfaHint: Enter the six-digit code from your authenticator app.
auth.mfaRecoveryHint: Enter one of the recovery codes you saved when you set up two-factor sign-in. Each works once.
auth.mfaWrong: That code isn't right. Check that your phone's clock is set automatically.
auth.mfaLocked: Too many wrong codes. Wait a few minutes and try again.
auth.mfaExpired: That sign-in expired. Enter your password again.
auth.accountSuspended: This account is suspended and can't sign in. If you think that's a mistake, contact support.
auth.oauthFailed: Signing in with that account didn't work. Try again, or sign in with your email and password.
auth.oauthMfaHint: Your Google, Apple or GitHub sign-in worked, and this account also uses two-factor sign-in.
auth.oauthMfaExpired: That sign-in expired before the two-factor step. Sign in again to enter your code.
twofa.title: Two-factor sign-in
twofa.off: Off. Add a code from an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, 1Password, Authy…) to every sign-in, so a stolen password isn't enough.
twofa.on: On. Sign-in asks for a code from your authenticator app. {n} recovery codes left.
twofa.scan: Scan this QR code with your authenticator app.
twofa.manual: Or enter this key by hand:
twofa.openApp: Open in an authenticator app on this device
twofa.confirmHint: Enter the code the app shows now to finish.
twofa.qrAlt: QR code for your authenticator app
twofa.recoveryHint: Save these recovery codes somewhere safe. If you lose your phone, each one signs you in once. They won't be shown again.

appSignin.hint: You signed in here, in your browser. Confirm to finish signing in to the app.

appSignin.badRequest: This sign-in link is incomplete or has expired. Start signing in again from the Mahaam app.
